name: Haha, You Clowns
s: Haha You Clowns follows three sweet natured brothers who, alongside their deeply caring father, embark on various adventures as they bond together in the wake of their mother's passing.

paragraphs.text: Haha, You Clowns is an American adult animated comedy television series created by Joe Cappa for Cartoon Network's nighttime programming block Adult Swim. It is based on the 2023 Adult Swim Smalls series of the same name, and is the first Small to be picked up as a full series. The series premiered on Adult Swim on October 19, 2025, although the first episode premiered on Adult Swim's YouTube channel two weeks prior on October 7, 2025. In December 2025, the series was renewed for a second and third season.

Tom Campbell is a local weatherman who lives in a big house with his three sons: Tristan, Preston, and Duncan. While Tom is still grieving the death of his beloved wife, his sons are always there to keep him grounded.
Haha, You Clowns has received positive reviews from The Wall Street Journal and BubbleBlabber.
